tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding comparison for Bramblequill
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of three charitable funding approaches for Nia and Owen Bramblequill: gifting appreciated Apricot Compass Technologies shares, using a donor-advised account, and giving cash. Show how each affects taxable income, portfolio concentration (currently 14% in employer shares vs. 10% guideline), and cash retained for tuition and the $76,000 renovation, targeting a $250,000 charitable fund within three years for arts education and first-generation college access.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare the comparison by December 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Verify Moonbadger Arts Foundation securities gift requirements
tickets.text: Verify Moonbadger Arts Foundation's process for a large publicly traded securities gift from Nia and Owen Bramblequill, including delivery instructions, designation language for arts education, and the receipt wording needed for tax records. Note that gifts above $100,000 require pre-clearance.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to verify those requirements by December 9, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable deduction tax projection for Bramblequill
tickets.text: Prepare a tax projection for Nia and Owen Bramblequill showing charitable deduction capacity and any carryforward, using their compensation, unrealized gains, mortgage interest, and prior giving level ($18,000 cash gifts on 2024 return). The deduction limit and possible carryforward are material before making a year-end transfer toward the $250,000 charitable fund.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that projection by December 17, 2025.
